newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart Dec same-store sales rise 6.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart Dec same-store sales rise 6.8 pct.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc said Tuesday that net sales for the five week period ended January 3, 1997, were $14,126,000,000, an increase of 11.7 percent from the $12,648,000,000 in the similar period in the prior year. For the 48 week period ended January 3, 1997, sales increased 11.5 percent to $97,416,000,000.
Comparable sales for the periods were:
This Year Last Year This Year Last Year

Sam's Clubs sales for the five week period were $2,311,000,000, up 6.0 percent from $2,181,000,000 in the similar prior year period. Club sales for the 48 weeks of $18,300,000,000 were up 3.4 percent over the similar prior year period.
Comparable sales for the nine week period beginning November 2, 1996, and ending January 3, 1997, were up 5.3 percent and 7.0 percent for the discount stores and clubs, respectively.

As of December 31, 1996, the Company had 1,947 Wal-Mart stores, 336 Supercenters, 436 Sam's Clubs, 6 Argentina units, 5 Brazilian units, 136 Canadian Wal-Mart stores, 2 China stores, 1 Indonesian Supercenter, 152 Mexican units, and 11 Puerto Rico units.
